title: Mixed Event — Wonder Magical Showtime! — Episode7 My Feelings Will Go On

meta.Episode: Episode7 — My Feelings Will Go On
meta.Event Outline: Phoenix Wonderland is faced with a transformation at the hands of Emu's brothers to appeal to the young adult crowd. In order to make sure it stays a place that makes everyone smile, Wonderlands×Showtime prepares a new show. In time, the curtain rises on a show unlike any other!

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Villager
rows.Line: “I haven't been able to move my legs since the war ended. I wish I could run and feel the wind in my hair again...”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Ah, you wish to run? Why don't I do you one better and make it so you can soar through the sky like a dragon! Here...!”

rows.Speaker: Villager
rows.Line: “W-What is this thing...?!”

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line:
It's a roller coaster!
It looks just like a dragon!

rows.Speaker: Kid
rows.Line: “The war made it so my sister can't laugh or be surprised anymore. It's like she can't feel anything at all...!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Yes, I see. This may be a little intimidating at first, but how about something like this? Here...!”

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line:
Hey, look!
The haunted house is lit up to look really scary!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: How have you not gained access to the control room yet?!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
I'm sorry!
I've been entering in the correct password, but I think someone's changed it...!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What?! Have we been hacked...?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Emu...
I hope you know what's coming...

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
“Excuse me!
I received word that some kind of sorcerer has taken up residence here! Is that actually true?!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Uh oh, it's the Ms. Windbag...”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Ms. Windbag?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “She won't stop yelling and complaining, so she's called Ms. Windbag.”

rows.Speaker: Elderly Person
rows.Line: “She used to be such a kind and cheerful girl too. But the war turned her into a completely different person.”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
“Silence!
You have no idea what I've been through!”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “My home was destroyed, and we were forced to live on borrowed goods and handouts! My mother's even become bedridden because of this meager lifestyle!”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “If only we could go back to those days when we could take warm baths and have gourmet meals every day...”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Don't you think that's asking a little too much?”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Hahaha! I don't think so! Happiness comes in all shapes and sizes!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Let's see. A simple mansion likely won't do, so why don't we just go for a giant castle?! There...!”

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The Neo Phoenix Castle's all lit up...!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Oh, this is just magnificent!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Whoa! Hey, look! It's sparkling!

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “And let's try this too...!”

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Fireworks...
How are they able to launch so many at once...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Wait... They're drones! Countless drones are flying around the castle and launching fireworks at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “Wonderful! This is just the kind of castle I was hoping for...!”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “My mother will surely start feeling better once she sees this! Thank you so much!”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “But you're quite a famous sorcerer, are you not? Why are you making all these things in a place like this?”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Ah, the answer is simple... It's because it's fun! Right, Shao?”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“What?!
Isn't this supposed to be a part of my training?!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Hahaha! Yes, there is that too!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Just take it one step at a time and you'll be just fine! You should come and see us again sometime, miss!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “You'll always be welcome here!”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
“Yes, I shall!
I'll even bring my mother next time!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “A long time had then passed since master and I first came to this field...”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “People from all over began gathering here as he made more and more stuff.”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “And as the years went by, I grew up to become an adult while master became a little old grandpa.”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Master, do you need more water?”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line:
“No, that's alright...
I have plenty already.”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Master, I'm so worried...”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “What's going to happen to this place once you're gone...?”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Because you're still using your magic, master, those spinning horses and flying rides are all still in working order.”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “But there's just no way that I could keep all of them running like that for this long.”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “So please... Don't leave me, master...”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Shao, you have such a beautiful smile...”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “When you first came to me and asked to become my apprentice, I was astonished at how a child like you could have such a sour expression on their face...”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “But you have such a beautiful smile now. One that can cheer up all those around you. You really are my best pupil.”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Master...”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line:
“Listen, Shao...
Smiles and laughter have a curious quality to them.”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “When one person begins to laugh, everybody around them becomes infected with their joy. It makes it so that people can feel hope and optimism.”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Almost as if it were magic.”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Shao, I'm sure you already understand.”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line:
“Magic is not what creates joy.
Joy is what creates magic.”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “That is why you, Shao, were able to become such a wonderful sorcerer. It's because you were immersed in smiles, laughter and joy for so long.”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “No, not just you. Everyone here. They're all sorcerers in their own right...”

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
What...?!
Did all the lights in the park just go out...?!

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “No...! Master...!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“The lights went out...
The horses and the flying rides...
They've all just stopped...!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“No, I don't want this to happen...!
Master worked so hard to build this place for everybody here...!!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“Wait, no...
This is no time to be crying...”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “If what master said is true, that means I can...! No, we can...!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Everyone...!! Can you hear me?!”

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: Huh? Does she mean us?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: We hear you, Shao!

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Everyone, please! Lend me your energy!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “This was the last thing master told me! Everybody here can use magic because you're all smiling, laughing and making this such a happy place...!!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “I can't do this alone! I'm not as good at using magic like master was, so please, lend me your energy...!!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Lend me your smiles, your joy, your magic...!!”

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: Lend you our energy...? L-Like this...? Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: These bracelets light up when you raise your hands...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: These bracelets...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: They have sensors built into them so that they glow when everyone raises their hands during the finale...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: You can do it, Shao...!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: We believe in you!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Each guest is lighting up one by one. It's as if their smiles really are the source of all this magic...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: No way...

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Everyone...! Thank you...!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“I'm gonna try, master!
I'm gonna use this energy to make everyone smile...!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Please...!”
se_event_wonders_2021_009

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: Look, the sky's all lit up! It's so beautiful...!!

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line:
This is unbelievable!
I have to get a picture of this!

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: Nana, look! There's so many stars!

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line:
They're beautiful, aren't they...?
I've never seen anything like this...

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “I did it! I did it, master...!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “It really worked... I got everyone to smile!”
se_event_wonders_2021_004

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: I don't believe this! I've never seen any special effects like this before!

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: This is amazing! Thank you, Shao!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
No, what am I doing...?!
Now's not the time to be admiring any of this!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
All of you, hurry!
The show's over, so we need to get them out of here right now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <And so, Shao and all of these people's magic helped bring happiness to everyone♪>

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Hm? This voice...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And they all lived happily ever after♪>
se_event_wonders_2021_009

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Look! It's Miku!

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's floating in the sky!
Is she being projected or something?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: H-Hatsune Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Well, the story's over, but we're not done here yet...!>
song00006_off_f

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yeah! Let's have a big party to cap everything off!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <We're about to make everything happier and more fun than before♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So let's smile, laugh and have a really good time☆ Starting... Now!>

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Incredible...!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The lighting schemes for all the rides and attractions just changed completely...
